# Piper Voices Repository Notice

The bundled voice files were obtained from:

- Repository: <https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices>
- Repository revision inspected for this notice:
  `0d907f158acc877ddeebcbf827659ee13bea8bcd`
- Repository metadata license identifier: `mit`
- Repository author/organization: `rhasspy`

At the inspected revision, the repository README declares `license: mit` in
its Hugging Face metadata but does not contain a separate repository-level
license text file. The original model cards are preserved under
`third_party/model_cards/`, and the dataset license texts they identify are
preserved under `third_party/licenses/`.

The repository-level metadata does not override model-specific dataset or
training-source terms. See `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for per-model provenance,
hashes, modification status, and the Lessac lineage notice.
